stimulus: a. What types of jars did Rosamond saw in the chemist's shop? b. How were Rosamond's shoes? c. What did Rosamond mean when she said "my heart is in that beautiful jar"? d. What did Rosamond buy finally? On what argument? e. What was Rosamond's mother's financial condition?
guide_solution: a. Rosamond saw blue, green, red, yellow and purple jars in the chemist's shop. b. Rosamond's shoes were quite worn out and mere was a hole in of her shoes. c. Rosamond finally decided to buy the purple jar on the argument that her shoes were not so bad except for the hole in one. e. Rosamond's mother did not have much money.
